newsitem.title: USA: BPA offers peak power Mon, Tues at $25-26 per MWh.
newsitem.headline: BPA offers peak power Mon, Tues at $25-26 per MWh.

text.p: The Bonneville Power Administration (BPA) offered up to 500 megawatts during peak demand hours (0100-0600, 2300-2400 PST) on Monday and Tuesday at $25.00-26.00 per megawatt hour (MWh) the agency said Friday.
BPA had offered firm power only during off-peak and shoulder hours for Friday.
Monday and Tuesday prices for firm off-peak power were unchanged at $12.50 per MWh.
Non-firm off-peak power was offered at $12.50 to $14.00.
Non-firm power was also offered during shoulder hours (0700, 1100-1700 and 2100-2200) at $25.00 for Northwest deliveries and $26.00 for California-Oregon border (COB) sales.
BPA also continued to offer displacement power for hours ending 0100-0500 and 2400 PST at $9.00 per MWh.
